name: VibeCanvas
tagline: Fullstack AI graphic design editor with background removal and templates
description:
An in-browser graphic design suite inspired by Canva. Create social media posts, apply typography presets, generate AI backgrounds, and export high-res PNG/PDF files with zero paywalls.

Vibecoded with Next.js 14, Fabric.js, and Hono using Cursor and Claude Code over a 3-day hack sprint.

replaces.note: Drag-and-drop graphic creation and AI background tools without Canva Pro export restrictions.
